t: This is the Special Operations Executive Memorial, a war memorial that includes a bust of Violette Szabo. It was made by Karen Newman, a British sculptor best known for this bronze bust on the Albert Embankment, outside Lambeth Palace. Szabo was a British-French agent in the Special Operations Executive during the Second World War. Captured on her second mission into occupied France, she was deported to Ravensbrück and executed there. She was awarded the George Cross after her death.
